description: Assainissement : Artisans et industriels (ARTISANS) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Data from the departmental sewerage network, the Haras de Jardy network (private domain of the Department) and the SIAVRM network, structuring municipal networks and the structuring network of the City of Paris, coming from SEVESC. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Sanitation: Craftsmen and industrialists (ARTISANS)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2017-12-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
